headline: Audrius Radvilavičius: Energy windfall profits: who will dictate the rules – the state or "Orlen"?
summary: Lithuanian commentary questions whether the state can consider additional taxes on Orlen's energy windfall profits, despite the company's status as a strategic investor.
why: Orlen is Poland's state-controlled refiner and owns Lithuania's largest fuel business, so windfall taxes directly affect its profits and investment plans.

impacts.name: Orlen
impacts.why: Possible windfall taxation would reduce profits from energy sales in Lithuania.
